    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Nature Prowler](/Feats.aspx?ID=5411) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Ranger" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=682" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 59

</column>

---

When you begin your turn [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=79) or [unnoticed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=98) by your hunted prey, that creature is [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) to you until the end of your turn. If you're in natural surroundings, you can [Avoid Notice](/Actions.aspx?ID=2669) and [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=2405) at full speed.
name: Nature Prowler
